description: Integrates ShellCheck into VS Code, a linter for Shell scripts.
capabilities.untrustedWorkspaces.descrip: Only the user defined `shellcheck` executable will be taken into account when running in untrusted mode. The experimental WebAssembly runtime is sandboxed and is unaffected.
capabilities.virtualWorkspaces.descripti: Only the experimental WebAssembly runtime (`shellcheck.runtime`: `wasm`) can lint documents of a virtual workspace. The native runtime needs a local `shellcheck` binary and files on the local disk. VS Code for the Web always uses the WebAssembly runtime.

config.title: ShellCheck
config.configFiles.title: Config Files
config.enable.description: Whether ShellCheck is enabled or not.
config.enableQuickFix.description: Whether to enable the _Quick Fix_ feature or not.
config.markdownDiagnostics.markdownDescr: **Experimental:** Show a formatted ShellCheck hover with severity and rule documentation. VS Code also displays the original diagnostic; the Problems view is unchanged. [Read the documentation](https://github.com/vscode-shellcheck/vscode-shellcheck#shellcheckmarkdowndiagnostics).
config.executablePath.markdownDescriptio: Path to the `shellcheck` executable (bundled binaries will be used if empty). Only used when `#shellcheck.runtime#` is `native`, so it has no effect in VS Code for the Web.
config.runtime.markdownDescription:
**Experimental.** Which ShellCheck runtime to use. VS Code for the Web always uses `wasm` and ignores this setting.

- `native` — run the bundled or user-provided `shellcheck` executable. This is the default, and the only supported runtime on desktop.
- `wasm` — run a bundled WebAssembly (WASI) build of ShellCheck inside the editor. No executable is required and it works on every platform and in virtual workspaces, but linting is currently 3-4x slower than native, `#shellcheck.executablePath#` is ignored, and files outside the document's workspace folder are not visible to `source` directives or `.shellcheckrc` lookup.
config.runtime.enumDescriptions.0: Run the bundled or user-provided shellcheck executable.
config.runtime.enumDescriptions.1: Run the bundled WebAssembly build of ShellCheck (experimental, slower).
config.run.description: What triggers a lint: typing, saving, or only the Lint Current Document command.
config.exclude.markdownDescription: Exclude certain error codes. For example, to exclude [SC1017](https://shellcheck.net/wiki/SC1017), enter _1017_. Enumerated error codes can be found [in this gist](https://gist.github.com/nicerobot/53cee11ee0abbdc997661e65b348f375). Always prefer to use a `.shellcheckrc` file instead of this setting.
config.exclude.items.patternErrorMessage: Valid shellcheck error code should be 4-digit numbers, 1017 for example.
config.customArgs.markdownDescription: Custom arguments to pass to ShellCheck. Always prefer to use a `.shellcheckrc` file instead of this setting. When `#shellcheck.runtime#` is `wasm`, as it always is in VS Code for the Web, paths on your machine in these arguments do not resolve.
config.ignorePatterns.markdownDescriptio: Configure glob patterns for excluding files and folders by ShellCheck. Glob patterns are interpreted relative to the workspace's root folder. Read more about glob patterns [here](https://code.visualstudio.com/docs/editor/glob-patterns).
config.ignorePatterns.additionalProperti: The glob pattern to match file paths against. Set to true or false to enable or disable the pattern.
config.ignoreFileSchemes.description: Matching file schemes are being ignored by shellcheck. The default also covers the virtual documents of the GitHub Pull Requests extension.
config.useWorkspaceRootAsCwd.description: Whether to use the workspace root directory as the current working directory when launching `shellcheck`. Otherwise, the directory of the file being linted will be used.
config.runTimeout.markdownDescription: Seconds a `shellcheck` run may take before it is stopped, or `0` for no limit. A stopped run leaves the document's problems as they were. Only runs started after a change are stopped: a document whose run already hangs is linted again once it is closed and reopened. Only used when `#shellcheck.runtime#` is `native`, so it has no effect in VS Code for the Web; the `wasm` runtime always stops a run after 30 seconds.
config.maxConcurrentRuns.markdownDescrip: The most `shellcheck` processes to run at once, or `0` for no limit. Lints beyond it wait for a running one to finish. Only used when `#shellcheck.runtime#` is `native`, so it has no effect in VS Code for the Web; the `wasm` runtime always lints one document at a time.
config.logLevel.description: The trace level the extension logs at, defaults to 'info'.
config.disableVersionCheck.markdownDescr: Whether to disable shellcheck binary version check, which prompts for updating when an outdated version is found. The check only runs when `#shellcheck.runtime#` is `native`, so it has no effect in VS Code for the Web.
config.watchConfigFiles.workspace.markdo: Lint open documents again when a `.shellcheckrc` or `shellcheckrc` in the workspace is created, changed or deleted, along with a file passed with `--rcfile` in `#shellcheck.customArgs#` that lives in the workspace. Only the documents that can pick up the changed file are linted again, and never those passed `--norc`.
config.watchConfigFiles.user.markdownDes: Lint open documents again when a ShellCheck config file outside the workspace is created, changed or deleted: a `.shellcheckrc` or `shellcheckrc` in a folder above a workspace folder, `~/.shellcheckrc` and `$XDG_CONFIG_HOME/shellcheckrc` (`%APPDATA%\shellcheckrc` on Windows), and a file passed with `--rcfile` in `#shellcheck.customArgs#` that lives outside the workspace. Only used when `#shellcheck.runtime#` is `native`, the only runtime that can read these files, so it has no effect in VS Code for the Web.
walkthrough.whatsNew.title: What's New in ShellCheck
walkthrough.whatsNew.description: A status bar menu, VS Code for the Web, and more.
walkthrough.whatsNew.step.statusBar.desc: Click the ShellCheck icon on the right of the status bar to lint the current document, change when ShellCheck runs, or turn it off for this workspace.
walkthrough.whatsNew.step.statusBar.altT: Clicking the ShellCheck icon in the status bar opens its menu.
walkthrough.whatsNew.step.web.title: VS Code for the Web
walkthrough.whatsNew.step.web.descriptio: ShellCheck now checks your scripts on [vscode.dev](https://vscode.dev) and [github.dev](https://github.dev), with nothing to install.
walkthrough.whatsNew.step.web.altText: ShellCheck reports a problem while typing in VS Code for the Web.
walkthrough.whatsNew.step.wasm.title: A bundled WebAssembly build
walkthrough.whatsNew.step.wasm.descripti:
The extension now bundles a WebAssembly build of ShellCheck. It runs on every platform with no shellcheck binary to install, stays sandboxed to your workspace files, and powers ShellCheck on the web.
[Try the WebAssembly Runtime](command:shellcheck.useWasmRuntime)
walkthrough.whatsNew.step.wasm.altText: The bundled WebAssembly build runs on every platform, in a sandbox, and on the web.
walkthrough.whatsNew.step.configFiles.de:
ShellCheck can lint your open scripts again as soon as a .shellcheckrc changes, so new rules apply without reopening files. Turn on shellcheck.watchConfigFiles.workspace for config files in your workspace, and shellcheck.watchConfigFiles.user for ones outside it, such as ~/.shellcheckrc. Both are off by default.
[Open Config File Settings](command:workbench.action.openSettings?%5B%22shellcheck.watchConfigFiles%22%5D)
walkthrough.whatsNew.step.configFiles.al: Changing .shellcheckrc lints the open scripts again.
